Windows Laptop.comment: This NamePrint is the default value used for a Windows hostname, which is then used for a Bluetooth Device Name in some Microsoft beacon packets. AFAIK it will be constant over time, and unique to a given host.
Windows Laptop.evidence_URL: The packet types are these: https://web.archive.org/web/20240621171934/https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-cdp/77b446d0-8cea-4821-ad21-fabdf4d9a569, however the presence of the name seems to be out of spec, and only when NearShareAuthPolicyPermissive bit is set (based on observed data).
